text: NSN (Never Say Never) is a global sports and entertainment company co-founded by Andrés Iniesta, with Joel Borràs as president and founder. In November 2025 Stoneweg became a shareholder of NSN as the two formed the joint venture behind the NSN Cycling Team.
short: NSN is co-founded by Andrés Iniesta and led by founder-president Joel Borràs; Stoneweg took a stake in NSN in 2025.

source.name: NSN Cycling Team, 'NSN and Stoneweg launch the NSN Cycling Team'
source.quote: Stoneweg becomes a shareholder of NSN, with the aim of continuing to support major projects in the world of sport and entertainment

additionalSources.name: NSN Cycling Team, 'About'
additionalSources.quote: global sports and event company NSN (Never Say Never), co-founded by Spanish football legend Andrés Iniesta, and Swiss investment firm Stoneweg
